nodes.label: init/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Initial Prisma migration creating the core lead-scraping schema: SearchTask, Lead and LeadEmail tables.

nodes.label: SearchTask
nodes.summary: Scraping job table (keyword, domainIdea, country, cityState, searchDepth, status, progress, totalLeads, validEmails, timestamps) tracking an outbound lead-discovery run.

nodes.label: Lead
nodes.summary: Discovered business lead (businessName, website, location, googleMapsLink, category, rating, reviewsCount, phoneNumbers, socialLinks, domainMatchScore, companySize, summary) linked to a SearchTask.

nodes.label: LeadEmail
nodes.summary: Email address extracted for a Lead (email, status, confidenceScore, sourcePage).

nodes.label: sync_schema/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Large sync migration (409 lines) adding the full outbound-email platform schema: users, campaigns, templates, sender accounts, sequences, email logs/events, replies, analytics, webhooks, suppression and audit tables plus unique indexes.

nodes.label: User
nodes.summary: Application user (email, name, role, isActive, timezone, locale, timestamps).

nodes.label: Campaign
nodes.summary: Outbound campaign (objective, geoDomain, niche, tone, status, dailyLimit, smart-delay and send-window config, A/B-test flag, metadata) owned by a User.

nodes.label: Template
nodes.summary: Email template (type, purpose, subject, previewText, body, followUpBody, variables, aiPrompt, spam/deliverability scores, tags) used by sequences.

nodes.label: SenderAccount
nodes.summary: Sending mailbox/account (provider, fromName/fromEmail, replyTo, daily/hourly limits, warmup, rotation, DKIM/SPF/DMARC status, deliverability/bounce metrics).

nodes.label: Sequence
nodes.summary: Email sequence belonging to a Campaign (name, status).

nodes.label: SequenceStep
nodes.summary: Single step in a Sequence (templateId, stepOrder, delayHours, stepType, subject/body, useAI, stopOnReply, metadata).

nodes.label: CampaignLead
nodes.summary: Per-lead campaign enrollment/state (status, stage, currentStep, nextSendAt, engagement flags, scores, tracking/unsubscribe tokens, attemptCount).

nodes.label: EmailLog
nodes.summary: Record of an individual sent email (provider, providerMessageId, to/from, subject, body text/html, status, tracking tokens, lifecycle timestamps, error, metadata).

nodes.label: EmailEvent
nodes.summary: Tracking event for an email (type, payload, ipAddress, userAgent, provider, occurredAt) tied to a campaign/lead/log.

nodes.label: Reply
nodes.summary: Inbound reply to an outbound email (fromEmail, subject, body, threadId, sentiment, intentScore, buyingIntent, status, suggestedResponse, tags).

nodes.label: AnalyticsSnapshot
nodes.summary: Per-day per-campaign analytics aggregate (sent, delivered, opens, clicks, replies, bounces, unsubscribes, complaints, engagement/deliverability scores).

nodes.label: WebhookEvent
nodes.summary: Inbound provider webhook record (provider, type, externalId, payload, processed flag).

nodes.label: SuppressionEntry
nodes.summary: Suppression-list entry (email, reason, source) preventing future sends to an address.

nodes.label: AuditLog
nodes.summary: Audit trail entry (userId, entityType, entityId, action, payload) for platform changes.
